contents.name: §1.3.1 Case of constant coefficients
contents.support: The source derives Fourier-mode evolution and the symmetric energy estimate for a constant-coefficient first-order system; the local lemma includes a complete proof and extends it to positive-semidefinite damping and Schwartz preservation.

source_review.read_extent: Retrieved and inspected the full 102-page PDF. Read §1.3.1 (PDF pp. 7–8), §1.3.2 (PDF p. 8), and §1.3.4 (PDF pp. 11–12), including the Fourier-mode calculation and the shrinking-cone energy proof.
source_review.supports: lem-tgr-constant-linear-energy-causality; its explicit symmetrized applications in lem-tgr-perfect-linear-causality and lem-tgr-bulk-linear-causality
source_review.limitations: The source leaves parts of existence/regularity as exercises; no missing argument is imported, and the local proof supplies the matrix exponential, Duhamel bounds, and full Schwartz construction.

contents.name: §1.3.2 Plane Wave solutions
contents.support: The section analyzes plane-wave solutions of first-order hyperbolic systems; the local lemma verifies its exact acoustic modes and negative-response growth by substitution.

source_review.read_extent: Retrieved and inspected the full 102-page PDF. Read §1.3.1 (PDF pp. 7–8), §1.3.2 (PDF p. 8), and §1.3.4 (PDF pp. 11–12), including the Fourier-mode calculation and the shrinking-cone energy proof.

contents.name: §1.3.4 Finite speed of propagation
contents.support: The source gives a cone-energy proof of finite propagation; the local lemma supplies the moving-ball derivative and handles its stated damping term and periodic lifts.
